title: New lower bounds on domination--packing ratios in connected subcubic and cubic graphs
summary: For a graph \(G\), let \(γ(G)\) and \(ρ(G)\) denote its domination number and packing number, respectively. Let \(c_{\mathrm{sub}}\) and \(c_{\mathrm{cub}}\) denote the respective limsups of \(γ(G)/ρ(G)\) over connected subcubic and connected cubic graphs as \(ρ(G)\to\infty\). We prove \[ c_{\mathrm{sub}}\geq\frac{13}{6}, \qquad c_{\mathrm{cub}}\geq\frac{17}{8}, \] by constructing two explicit binary branching families.
